text: You said you didn't know yet what the tower was for.
You asked who was buying the coffee.
You said you think about stopping. Every day.
You stayed for ten minutes of terrible coffee.
You asked what she would do instead.
You let her show you the gauges at three in the morning.
You slept at your desk. She left you the blanket.
You stood in the cold room with her.
You asked her to come home and sleep.
You held her hand at the window.
You promised to remember the people outside.
You took FORM A-5 home to sleep on it.
You read FORM A-5 with her.
You said yes. She's staying.
You asked her to wait.
You said no. She thanked you for saying it straight.
You gave her the coolant distribution unit. She checked the gauges first.
You gave her the gas turbine.
You said the tower should outlive us.
You bought the certificate.
You bought the panels for the north wall.
You took the diesel.
You turned the diesel down.
You said you'd keep an eye on the ferns.
You said it was just ferns.
You watered a fern with her.
You walked the outfall in her spare boots.
You said the river was dying anyway.
You sold only the credits you'd earned.
You sold the credits, all of them.
You said you'd bring the good wrench.
You lay on the warm panels with her.
You counted the lit windows with her.
You held the bucket while she used the good wrench.
You said you'd come up every morning.
You said yes. Properly.
You asked her for a bit.
You said no. She said thanks for the answer.
You gave her the heat recovery unit. She said hi to it.
You gave her the diesel genset.
You said a copy of you would be you.
You said it would be someone else.
You asked if she'd want it to be you.
You asked if she was all right.
You asked what the cultures need.
You said they'd adapt.
You held the jar.
She wrote a word on your hand.
You seeded the ducts.
You let it grow at its own pace.
You said you'd be the first.
You held the first jar with her.
You told her your first memory. A green door.
You sat on the cushion.
She undid the cuff for you.
You let her hold your wrist.
You said yes. Next to her.
You asked for time to think.
You said no. She thanked you for the clear result.
You gave her the nutrient tank. She said it was warm.
You gave her the outside-air economizer.
You said the tower was for money.
You let her sign FORM A-5.
You signed the fuel deal.
You refused the fuel deal.
You made her read the small print.
You asked what she wanted.
You took her hand when the lights flickered.
You told her her hand was shaking.
You told her she could say it whenever.
You held her hand until it stopped.
You stayed until the numbers closed.
You left your name in pencil.
You had your name inked.
You walked the aisle with her. Eighty-one paces.
You took the gold pen.
You took her hand at dawn.
You said yes.
You said not yet. The offer's still open.
You said no. She said she'd have it filed.
You gave her the inference accelerator. She read the sheet twice.
You gave her the algae facade.
